descriptions.w3d_d26k_team_panel_update_8021c48c: When the panel is active and CurrentTeamIndex is set, enters the app state (0x80129878) and posts a value-1 message inside the 2999 tick window with a non-negative start time, and otherwise leaves it (0x801298cc) and posts value 0, tracking the state in 0x804abab4.
